query:
UPDATE coupon.users
                SET status = 'ACTIVE', suspended_at = NULL, suspension_reason = NULL,
                    version = version + 1
                WHERE id = $1
                  AND status = 'SUSPENDED'
                  AND withdrawn_at IS NULL
                  AND NOT EXISTS (
                      SELECT 1 FROM coupon.user_sanctions s
                      WHERE s.subject_user_id = $1 AND s.status = 'ACTIVE'
                  )
